recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No further FHIR core source action is indicated for FHIR-15913; examples about accountable provider groups should remain in the relevant IG trail if needed.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 request to remove Group from MeasureReport.reporter because Groups are collections/subjects, not actors able to report data or take collective responsibility.
initial_application: SVN 14046, preserved as git commit e169985949ad77cfed6c6e86ee8036a90f98136e, removed Group from the historical MeasureReport spreadsheet reporter choices. Group was later reintroduced by FHIR-28941 when DEQM extensions were made first-class, and removed again by FHIR-38002 commit c6487923f555ea1723187bdb34ed052de50ae9d6.
additional_context: FHIR-31686 temporarily accepted the R5 Group target as sufficient for an NHSN use case, but FHIR-38002 later superseded that rationale and confirmed that Organization and PractitionerRole cover provider-group reporting in core. MeasureReport is active in source/fhir.ini, and nearby measure operation reporter parameters align with Practitioner, PractitionerRole, or Organization.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current authoritative StructureDefinition already targets Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and Organization only for MeasureReport.reporter.

related_jiras.note: Reintroduced Group on reporter while incorporating DEQM MeasureReport extensions as first-class R5 elements.
No Change issue that accepted the then-planned R5 Group target before later reconsideration.
Applied issue that removed Group from MeasureReport.reporter again and controls the current source state.
